import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("evidence-driven-dev/tasks/ollama-planning-mvp")
files={}
for name in ("background-brief.md","subagent-proposal.md","integrated-plan.md"):
 p=root/"reports"/name
 b=p.read_bytes()
 s=b.decode("utf-8")
 assert not b.startswith(bytes([239,187,191])),name
 files[name]={"characters":len(s.rstrip("\n")),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"utf8_no_bom":True}
assert files["background-brief.md"]["characters"]<=1000
tracked=subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","HEAD","--name-only"],text=True,encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
assert not tracked,tracked
head=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip()
assert head=="bc09c67fc4078501599c37e4cdfecdee40af2ef8"
task=json.loads((root/"task.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("---",2)[1])
assert all(a["integrated"] for a in task["agents"])
report={"artifact_validation":"PASS","model_quality":"NOT_VERIFIED","files":files,"head":head,"tracked_changes":tracked,"agent_handoff_integrated":True,"new_model_calls":0,"new_sql_or_db_calls":0}
(root/"reports"/"artifact-verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
output_policy: 原始輸出僅保留於 Git 忽略目錄；分享前審查敏感資料
